description: Returns a list of the last bad blocks that the client has seen on the network.

block.description: A block object, or null when no block was found

block.baseFeePerGas.description: The integer of the difficulty for this block encoded as hexadecimal

block.difficulty.description: The integer of the difficulty for this block encoded as hexadecimal

block.extraData.description: The extra data field of this block

block.gasLimit.description: The maximum gas allowed in this block encoded as hexadecimal

block.gasUsed.description: The total used gas by all transactions in this block encoded as hexadecimal

block.hash.description: The block hash of the requested block. Null if pending

block.logsBloom.description: The bloom filter for the logs of the block. Null if pending

block.miner.description: The address of the beneficiary to whom the mining rewards were given

block.mixHash.description: A string of a 256-bit hash encoded as hexadecimal

block.nonce.description: The hash of the generated proof-of-work. Null if pending

block.number.description: The block number of the requested block encoded as hexadecimal. Null if pending

block.parentHash.description: The hash of the parent block

block.receiptsRoot.description: The root of the receipts trie of the block

block.sha3Uncles.description: The SHA3 of the uncles data in the block

block.size.description: The size of this block in bytes as an Integer value encoded as hexadecimal

block.stateRoot.description: The root of the final state trie of the block

block.timestamp.description: The unix timestamp for when the block was collated

block.transactions.description: An array of transaction objects with the following fields:

block.transactions.blockHash.description: The hash of the block where this log was in. Null when it's a pending log

block.transactions.blockNumber.description: The block number where this log was in. Null when it's a pending log

block.transactions.gas.description: The gas provided by the sender, encoded as hexadecimal

block.transactions.gasPrice.description: The gas price provided by the sender in wei, encoded as hexadecimal

block.transactions.maxFeePerGas.description: The maximum fee per gas set in the transaction

block.transactions.maxPriorityFeePerGas.description: The maximum priority gas fee set in the transaction

block.transactions.input.description: The data sent along with the transaction

block.transactions.nonce.description: The number of transactions made by the sender before this one encoded as hexadecimal

block.transactions.to.description: The address of the receiver. Null when it's a contract creation transaction

block.transactions.transactionIndex.description: The integer of the transaction's index position that the log was created from. Null when it's a pending log

block.transactions.value.description: The value transferred in wei encoded as hexadecimal

block.transactions.accessList.description: A list of addresses and storage keys that the transaction plans to access

block.transactions.chainId.description: The chain id of the transaction, if any

block.transactions.v.description: The standardized V field of the signature

block.transactions.r.description: The R field of the signature

block.transactions.s.description: The S field of the signature

block.transactionsRoot.description: The root of the transaction trie of the block
